title: Learning neuroimaging models from health system-scale data

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring True Positive Rate (TPR) disparity and turnaround time odds ratios across patient populations based on geographic region and population density (e.g., rural vs. urban).
Evaluating TPR disparity and turnaround time odds ratios based on the timing of the MRI scan (e.g., weekday vs. weekend or holiday).
Evaluating algorithmic fairness via the equalized odds framework by calculating TPR and FPR disparities between male and female patients.
Evaluating algorithmic fairness via the equalized odds framework by calculating TPR and FPR disparities across different racial groups.
Evaluating algorithmic fairness by calculating TPR disparities across different patient age cohorts.
Measuring TPR disparities across patients with different healthcare insurance statuses (e.g., Medicare, Medicaid, Private Insurance).
Evaluating TPR disparities across different MRI equipment manufacturers (e.g., Siemens, Philips, GE) and different interpreting radiologists.
Measuring TPR and FPR disparities across intersectional subgroups (e.g., Sex x Race, County x Sex) to evaluate compounding systemic biases.
